title: WarmSet@1 payload
description: The exact per-node set of carried layers one Round's Attempts start from, selected before the first AttemptDispatched@1 and listed in every Attempt's context manifest. Built only from the previous closed Round's admitted Attempt of the same node; fenced, quarantined, malformed and released Attempts contribute nothing. A retry inherits the Round's Warm Set, never its failed sibling's state. A Head Delta over its bound is dropped at selection with a recorded reason, so no renderer can refuse an already selected Warm Set. Later packages add session, workspace and build-cache layers as optional fields.

head_delta_dropped.description: Recorded when the Round's Head Delta was computed but exceeded its bound; never present beside head_delta_artifact_id.
